scripts.format: prettier --write "src/**/*.ts" "tests/**/*.ts" && cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/openbeacon-packet/Cargo.toml && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "src/**/*.ts" "tests/**/*.ts" && cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/openbeacon-packet/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check
scripts.lint: tsc --noEmit && cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path crates/openbeacon-packet/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings
scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.ts && cargo test --locked --manifest-path crates/openbeacon-packet/Cargo.toml && cargo test --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
